ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of child care fraud, including the amounts lost and the individuals involved.
questions: How much money has been lost to child care fraud?
Who are the key individuals involved?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money will reveal a complex web of transactions and individuals involved in the fraud, and I recommend using data analysis to track the financial trails.

ideas.title: The Impact of Government Shutdown on Programs
ideas.description: Investigate the potential impacts of a government shutdown on various programs and services.
questions: Which programs will be most affected by a government shutdown?
What are the potential consequences for services?
ideas.insight: I suspect that a government shutdown will have significant impacts on various programs and services, and I recommend researching the potential consequences for services and the individuals affected.
